jcr:title: Stryker Returns To The Barclays To Educate Golf Fans About Importance Of Joint Health And Staying Active

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., Aug. 22, 2016 /PRNewswire/ -- Stryker Orthopaedics, the Official Joint Replacement Products of the PGA TOUR® and PGA TOUR Champions®, returns to The Barclays to advance its commitment to the health and well-being of joint-pain sufferers, and enhance its longstanding history of supporting the nation's military though education, programs, products and donations.

On Thursday, Stryker will host a special ceremony with members and veterans of the United States Armed Forces at The Barclays to present a donation to K9s For Warriors for the sponsorship of a service dog, its third donation this year. Stryker's ongoing commitment to K9s For Warriors, a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing service canines to military veterans suffering from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder, traumatic brain injury or other military trauma as a result of military service post 9/11, will continue with a fourth donation at The Charles Schwab Cup Championship in Scottsdale, Arizona this fall.
